scope: Explicit nano-native-eth1-v1 profile extension; legacy and deposit-tracking-only profiles retain their identity
Stable per-voting-period execution ancestor selection; all native votes must refer to authenticated ancestors of their own parent
Strict Eth1 majority and pending deposit count predicted before assembling the local body
Mandatory SSZ deposits included with proofs and body/payload budgets
Signed funded mempool transaction executes, then automatic proposal admits validator 64 at slot 12 after five votes in an eight-slot test period
Before majority registry stays at 64; after admission grows to 65; epoch processing makes the new key activation-eligible
Unbacked vote refused before signing and at signed-block admission without checkpoint mutation
Corrupted mandatory Merkle proof refused before signer; exact admission block replay does not republish checkpoint
Actual database reopen retains admitted validator, deposit cursor and EVM state
limits: Native Nano Eth1 source policy, not Ethereum external Eth1 timestamp/follow-distance selection or EIP-6110 activation
Synthetic one-epoch voting period, 64 initial validators on one host
New validator eligible but not active at scenario end; activation duties not yet qualified
No withdrawal payout, remote peer, partition, crash-injection or large-scale qualification for this new profile
Competing deposit allocations and pending exits must be qualified together
No network deployment or real funds
